description: WARNING: a diagnostic name does not make this process diagnose-safe: live read-shape calls can reach external systems. dry_run defaults to true and returns every classification row without dispatching. Live dispatch requires dry_run=false and defaults to read-shape service_interface providers only. The plugin's declared outward-facing namespace table is fail-closed: an unlisted provider is never inferred safe. An outward-facing plugin provider must be explicitly enumerated in external_namespaces and paired with an operator_confirmation turn/message id; that citation is echoed in result rows. write_enabled still gates only write-shape verbs. Not a startup-blocking gate — manual operator/CI invocation.
embedding_description: Diagnostic gate over the live process registry. Find registration mismatches, ParameterType ARRAY vs LIST drift, malformed invocation schemas, SQL operator type errors (integer = boolean), 'Process not found or malformed' wiring breakages. Run after platform changes touching service interfaces, plugin lifecycles, schema column types, or registry builder paths.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Per-process pass/fail report. Each row carries process_key, shape (read|write), status (ok|failed|skipped_*), error_class, error_message.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with the totals (total/ok/failed/skipped). When failed > 0, surface the first ~5 failing rows verbatim — process_key + error_class + error_message — so the operator can triage. Do NOT collapse or summarize failure text; the raw exception message is the diagnostic signal.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: The sweep itself failed before completing the iteration. Distinct from individual processes failing within a successful sweep (those land in the result rows, not as a top-level error).
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: An exception inside the sweep machinery (not inside an invoked process) most likely means the orchestrator reference is missing or the process_registry payload is malformed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Check that the plugin is loaded (list_plugins) and that the platform completed startup before invoking the verb.
